comments.author: luizebas
comments.body:
If you're starting from scratch, you'll have to follow these steps:

1) Syracuse: Investment of 300k to receive Book "Confectioner's Recipe"

Recipe from "Confectioner's Recipe": 2 Eggs + 2 Flour + 2 Sugar = 1-2 Baumkuchen

2) Quest "A lovely sweetshop" in Lisbon (Lisbon Merchant Mediator) (R10 Cooking)
Deliver 50 Baumkuchen to Christina in Lisbon Tavern
Receive Book "Renowned patissier's recipe book"

Recipe from "Renowned patissier's recipe book": 2 Flour + 1 Jam + 1 Vegetable Oil = 1-2 Le poupelin

3) Quest "Carlotta makes up her mind" in Lisbon (Lisbon Merchant Mediator) (R12 Cooking)
Deliver 100 Le poupelin to Christina in Lisbon Tavern
Receive "First grade patissier licence"

Where to Get the Trade Goods?
Eggs: buy in Faro or Calvi
Flour: buy Wheat in Porto, Sagres, Seville or Valencia
Sugar: buy in Madeira or Las Palmas
Jam: buy in Valencia
Vegetable Oil: collect in Nantes, Calais, or Africa North Coast
